title: Fuzzy rules for cognitive-offloading risk in student–LLM interaction: pre-registered audit of StudyChat and Study 2 on TutorTrace (code and analysis plans)
description: Version 1.1.0. Code, analysis plans (PREREG_*.md, each committed before its run; full history in the GitHub repository) and results. Study 1 (StudyChat): expert and learned TSK rule bases, Łukasiewicz implication constraints, cross-semester tests (E1–E12) and a pre-registered audit (R1–R1c) showing that the weak assisted-minus-unaided label is dominated by assessment-group structure; within assessment groups no behavioural input predicts it, so the behavioural conclusions of version 1.0.0 are not supported. Study 2 (TutorTrace): a pre-registered sign-checked TSK classifier for dependent AI help requests, trained on one classroom deployment and tested on others. No third-party data are redistributed.
